description: This file defines the UserAuthenticationController class for handling user login, logout, password reset, and login status via HTTP requests in a Drupal module. It manages authentication, flood control, CSRF tokens, and serialization.

classes.name: UserAuthenticationController
classes.description: Controller class providing login, logout, password reset, and login status endpoints for user authentication in Drupal.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the controller with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login requests, authenticates credentials, manages flood control, and returns user info with CSRF tokens.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Handles password reset requests by email or username.

methods.name: userIsBlocked
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if a user is blocked.

methods.name: loginStatus
methods.description: Returns login status of the current user.

methods.name: floodControl
methods.description: Enforces flood control for login attempts based on IP and user.

methods.name: getLoginFloodIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for flood control based on user ID and IP.
